summary: 10 concrete, comment-endorsed tools, learning resources, and media picks from a verified full front-page comment crawl.
telegram_footer: 10 items surfaced | 30/30 current front-page stories processed | history + run artifact updated.

items.name: LuaCAD
items.source_story_title: Show HN: LuaCAD – Parametric CAD Scripted in Lua
items.summary: A Lua-scripted parametric CAD tool praised as a welcome alternative to OpenSCAD.
items.why_included: A commenter gave direct approval while contrasting its approach with OpenSCAD's painful syntax.
items.evidence: A commenter said they loved LuaCAD and highlighted dissatisfaction with OpenSCAD's syntax.

evidence_sources.author: manny_rat
evidence_sources.excerpt: Love it! OpenSCAD has very painful syntax.

items.name: RustDesk
items.source_story_title: RustDesk now supports true unattended remote access on Wayland
items.summary: An open-source remote-desktop tool with new unattended Wayland access support.
items.why_included: It received concise, unequivocal long-term first-hand praise.
items.evidence: A long-time user said they love RustDesk.

evidence_sources.author: j_aime
evidence_sources.excerpt: I've been using rustdesk for years. I love it.

items.name: Miniflux
items.source_story_title: I turned my RSS feeds into an e-ink newspaper to stop reading on my phone
items.summary: A minimal RSS reader that can fetch full article text and integrate with Wallabag.
items.why_included: A heavy RSS user reported reliable full-text fetching across more than 150 subscriptions.
items.evidence: A commenter said Miniflux works very reliably and fails on fewer than five of their 150-plus feeds.

evidence_sources.author: MattTheRealOne
evidence_sources.excerpt: I use Miniflux which has an option to fetch the full article text and works very reliably.

items.evidence: A commenter reported using Voyage AI in production.

evidence_sources.author: dmix
evidence_sources.excerpt: I've been using https://www.voyageai.com/ for this in production.
